Strategy: Refine the item-size-gated worst-fit family: use worst fit when the item is at most half the loosest bin, Best Fit otherwise, add an exact-fit bonus, and add a band bonus when the leftover falls in [item/2, item]. The choice differs from Best Fit for items with a bin available, and from gated worst fit when the band bonus flips two loose bins. The bonuses may preserve leftovers, but stacking them can overrule tight fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if item * 2 <= max(bins) else -(r - item)) + (20 if item / 2 <= r - item <= item else 0) for r in bins]
```
